subject: Re: Co-hosted partner track at Embedded Dev Summit - CloudForge collaboration
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena@cloudforge.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
Cc: partners@cloudforge.com
Date: 2027-04-21T09:12:00Z
Subject: Embedded Dev Summit - partner track proposal

Hi Irene,

Hope you’re well — I run partnerships at CloudForge. We’re organizing the Embedded Dev Summit (Aug 18-19) and have a partner track reserved for embedded/edge LLM toolchains and runtimes. Given Redwood’s work on inference runtimes, we’d love to co-host a 40-minute session and a short 15-minute demo slot focused on "Optimizing LLM inference for constrained devices."

Attached is a short proposal with suggested formats, audience profile, and promotional asks (CloudForge-embedded-track-proposal.pdf). High-level asks from our side: co-presenter, two co-marketing mentions in the summit newsletter, and a 1-page partner blurb for the summit site. We typically aim for ~200 registrants for partner sessions and can help amplify to our audience.

Would Redwood be interested? If so, what format do you prefer (panel + demo vs. deep-dive talk)? I’ve looped Samir from the summit team on timing logistics.

Best,
Elena Rossi
Head of Partnerships, CloudForge

-- attachment: CloudForge-embedded-track-proposal.pdf (PDF, 420KB)
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@cloudforge.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-21T11:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Embedded Dev Summit - partner track proposal

Hi Elena — thanks for reaching out and for the proposal. Excited by the topic and the audience fit.

Quick thoughts:
- Format: I’d recommend a 30-min technical talk (Redwood lead) + 10-min co-demo (CloudForge) followed by a 10-min joint Q&A. Keeps it tight and demo-focused.
- Goals: surface platform differentiators (latency, KV caching, deployment modes) and capture 30-50 MQLs from the session.
- Speakers: I’ll speak to technical runtime takeaways; could we have a CloudForge engineer for the demo and an exec for a 2-3 min opening?

I’m looping Jonas (alliances) and Ben (field marketing) to coordinate logistics, promotional cadence, and the mutual action plan. I’ve attached a one-pager for Redwood that we can use on the partner page (Redwood-partner-onepager.pdf).

Next steps I suggest: Jonas to confirm slot and promotional commitments; Ben to share proposed email/social cadence and assets deadline; Elena to confirm speakers and send draft deck by May 10.

Thanks — Irene
Irene Choi
Director, Strategic Alliances | Redwood Inference
